name: taskflow
description: Full-stack personal task manager - NestJS + MongoDB API and a Next.js 15 dashboard.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run env:example
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta -k "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint:ci && npm --prefix frontend run lint:ci
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run build
